problem: Production was on the exact protected main SHA, but the NL/EN browser gate failed with 'visible mobile language select is missing'.
root_cause: The language select is mounted dynamically into multiple possible mobile hosts. The production verifier first raced visibility, then still selected the shared host by DOM presence via count(), so a hidden shared select could win over a visible legacy/compact select.
prevention: Treat dynamically mounted UI controls as asynchronous browser state.
Select mobile language controls by actual :visible state inside approved mobile hosts, never by DOM presence or locator count.
Wait for the chosen visible mobile language select before interacting with it.
Apply the same visibility-first selection on the English-to-Dutch return path.
Keep the functional NL→EN→NL navigation proof after the visibility wait.
Do not downgrade the gate to presence-only or remove the mobile proof.

evidence.latest_failed_assertion: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation
evidence.failure_mechanism: hidden shared selector was preferred by count() over visible mobile selector
